neighbors: There's Got to Be a Way
edges: The song 'There's Got to Be a Way' was recorded at Cove City Sound Studios.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mariah Carey is the artist who performed and wrote the song 'There's Got to Be a Way'.
The song 'There's Got to Be a Way' reached number 54 on the UK Singles Chart.
Ric Wake co-produced the song 'There's Got to Be a Way' with Mariah Carey.
Narada Michael Walden co-produced the song 'There's Got to Be a Way' with Mariah Carey.
The song 'There's Got to Be a Way' was recorded at The Power Station.
